summary: Re-tested the follow-ups from iteration 195. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass. assert_view_schedule returns 403 for Salim and Saeed on all 12 guarded GET endpoints (weekly-schedule, sections, conflicts, export-visual pdf/excel, availability rooms/teachers, master-view plus its pdf/excel exports, free-rooms, valid-slots), using valid params. Admin gets 200 on all of them and master-view returns can_manage=true. can_manage_schedule is now strict: drafts GET, weekly-schedule POST, drafts POST, rooms POST, schedule-settings PUT and slot DELETE all return 403 for Salim and Saeed. The teacher-id exception works: Saeed and Salim (who have teacher/course permissions) get 200 on weekly-schedule and export-visual with a specific teacher_id; a teacher gets 200 for their own id and 403 without one. GET /api/lectures/month now returns 404. Role toggle on رئيس قسم: with view_schedule only, Saeed sees just the 'الجدول' tab, the master view loads, and drafts returns 403. With manage_schedule added, all 4 tabs show, the drafts modal opens, and creating and deleting a TEST_ draft works (200/200). The role was restored to its exact original 28 permissions (restored equal: True). Admin regression all passes: the 4 tabs, master view, master Excel download, availability-report with results, the /schedule daily page, and the /teacher-courses weekly report modal plus Excel export (also passes for Saeed).

minor.issue: assert_view_schedule(also=('view_reports',)) is dead code because the next line still requires can_manage_schedule. Users with only view_reports or view_schedule (Salim has view_reports) get 403. Either drop the can_manage_schedule check so view-only and report users can see the availability report, or remove the view_reports allowance to be consistent.

Any user with view_courses/view_teachers/manage_* can pass teacher_id=zzz to get past the guard. weekly-schedule, conflicts and export results are filtered to empty, which is fine. valid-slots still returns per-cell occupancy for any faculty/department/level (reasons like 'الشعبة مشغولة'), a small information leak. Consider validating that teacher_id exists, or applying the teacher_id exception only where the result is filtered by teacher.

ui_bugs.component: weekly-schedule.tsx action bar (lines ~1013-1100) + slot card delete 'x'
ui_bugs.issue: A view-only user (view_schedule without manage_schedule) still sees the management buttons: توليد تلقائي, مسح, توليد المحاضرات, مزامنة الأوقات, حفظ نسخة, النسخ المحفوظة, إضافة يدوية, تقرير الفراغ and the 'x' delete on each slot card. Clicking النسخ المحفوظة calls GET /drafts, gets 403, and the global 403 handler redirects the user to /no-permission. تقرير الفراغ followed by تنفيذ التقرير also redirects to /no-permission. Wrap these buttons and the slot delete/edit actions with canManageSchedule; keep تصدير visible.

action_items: weekly-schedule.tsx: gate the management action buttons (auto-generate, clear, generate lectures, resync times, save draft, drafts, manual add, availability report) and the slot-card delete/edit actions behind canManageSchedule.
availability/rooms and availability/teachers: decide the policy. Either remove `if not can_manage_schedule` so view_schedule/view_reports users can use the report, or drop also=('view_reports',).
Optional: in assert_view_schedule, only honor the teacher_id exception when teacher_id is a real teacher (ObjectId valid and exists), to close the valid-slots occupancy leak.
critical_code_review_comments: assert_view_schedule calls ObjectId(user['id']) for teachers. This is fine for normal users but will raise if the id is ever non-ObjectId; guard with ObjectId.is_valid.
SCHEDULE_ROLES constant in weekly_schedule.py is now unused; remove it.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all required flows pass; view-only UX shows management buttons)

Saeed has no faculty_id but sees كلية البنات. Teacher حسن صالح id = 698e533beb4c6eb021c50302.
